display_long_description:
Think you know racing? Try doing it in a 5-ton beast!

Truck Racing offers a unique twist on the motorsport genre. Leave the trailers and speed limits behind. In this game, you take control of powerful semi-truck cabs (bobtails) and push them to their absolute limits on professional race tracks.

Drifting a sports car is one thing, but sliding a massive truck through a hairpin turn requires a whole new level of skill. Feel the weight, hear the roar of the diesel engines, and battle for the first place against tough AI rivals.

Key Features:

Heavyweight Racing: Experience the unique physics of racing trucks. Manage your momentum and braking points carefully to stay on the track.

Circuit Championship: Race across various tracks featuring grandstands, steep hills, and sharp corners.

Competitive AI: You are not alone on the asphalt. Battle for position against 4 other racers who won't give up the lead easily.

Arcade Fun: Jump in and race! Intuitive controls meet challenging gameplay for a fast-paced adrenaline rush.

Track Info HUD: Keep track of your lap times, speed (RPM), and position with a clear heads-up display.

The green light is on! Rev up your engine and dominate the circuit in Truck Racing.
